sections.text_helper: Section 70.3.10 "MDIOS interrupts" in chapter 70 (Management data input/output (MDIOS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3609.
sections.section_content:
There is a single interrupt vector for the three types of interrupts (write, read, and error).
Anyof these interrupt sources can wake the STM32 up from Stop mode. All interrupt flags
need to be cleared in order to clear the interrupt line.
[Table 690. Interrupt control bits]
